text:
Here, Kapel said,
But in regard to atheism, I'm not claiming that I have conclusive proof in order to know that God does not exist. Fine, I haven't claimed conclusive proof either. Remember I said my arguments were not down arguments. But I simply want to know what justification does he have for being an atheist. He knows that knowledge is more than just true belief.
There needs to be some justification, and I agree with that.
